utterances.speaker: granddaughter

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: That's great! Just make sure you're comfortable and safe while driving.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandpa! I'll definitely be careful. Do you have any tips for driving in the rain?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: It sounds like you're figuring it out. If you need any help, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: I understand, driving styles have changed over the years. Just make sure you're safe and comfortable with your method.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks for understanding, Grandpa. I'll make sure to stay safe and adapt as needed.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Alright, let's give it a try and see how it feels.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Sounds good, Grandpa! I'm ready to give it a shot.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: I'm glad you're feeling confident. Let's make sure we're both comfortable with the way you're driving.
